g.title: pcai_llm_gw
g.text: pcai-llm-gateway 4.2 — request path, routing, monitoring & control planes
blue: routing · green: fallback · orange: off-peak demand · purple: monitoring (fail-open) · teal: memory · amber: control plane

g.title: cluster_consumers
g.text: Consumers — a virtual key (hllm-…) on every data-plane call

g.title: cluster_control
g.text: Control plane — hash-only keys, every mutation audited

g.title: cluster_routing
g.text: Routing plane — how ONE model is chosen (pre-generation; a stream cannot switch mid-flight)

g.title: cluster_models
g.text: Model endpoints — pool by priority/weight, circuit breaker, admin-curated fallback chains

g.title: cluster_mon
g.text: Monitoring plane — Prometheus, in-cluster behind the MCP registry. Every read is CACHED and FAILS OPEN.

g.title: cluster_mcp
g.text: MCP fleet — reached ONLY through the in-cluster relay ③ call · ④ result back · per-tool default-DENY ACL

g.title: team
g.text: hard envelope over the team SUM

g.title: d3
g.text: sees a COMPACT summary, never the prompt

g.title: groups
g.text: equivalent models, pick by LIVE load

g.title: gate
g.text: key scope · model ACL · budget (key allocation + team envelope) · rate window

g.title: mem
g.text: session memory — automatic, no client changes
canonical capture → sweep → MAP-REDUCE distill → mm-rag write

g.title: db
g.text: PostgreSQL — the ledger IS the budget engine
budgets are SUMs — no "remaining" counter, no check-then-act race

g.title: offpeak->gate
g.text: billing fraction — budget consumes tokens × fraction

g.title: wb
g.text: no net · no GPU · no creds

g.title: legend
g.text: no routing decision → walk DeepSeek → GLM → Qwen; every hop re-gated
decision model, heuristics, or a model group picks ONE target
Prometheus demand → billing fraction AND the cascade entry; opt-in, sticky
cached reads, fail open: no discount, uniform random pick — never a stalled request
capture is universal (relayed + plain chat); distillation is automatic
admin (all) · team leader (its own enrollment only) — hash-only keys, audited
